description: Pinned, Apache-2.0 model artifacts that CI stages into the example app before it is built. The app itself never downloads: it loads the staged bundle from local storage after the probe verifies every file digest. CI only downloads already-published artifacts by immutable revision and checks every file against the sha256 and byte size below. It never converts or publishes models (docs/security/hf-token-policy.md).

ios.coreml_pending: No Core ML export of this checkpoint is published yet, and GitHub Actions must not convert models. A maintainer converts the tokenizer revision above locally (float32, cpuOnly compute units, max sequence length 512), publishes it manually under docs/security/hf-token-policy.md, and pins it here as {repo, revision, license, package_dir, id2label, files: [{path, sha256, bytes}]}. Until then the iOS staging step fails closed.
